# Original third-party skills for VANTARA

Installed 328 original SKILL.md packages from 20 pinned repositories.

Original source and supporting files: .claude/vendor/sources/

Claude discovery entrypoints: .claude/skills/ext-*/SKILL.md

All license and notice files are retained. Check installation-report.json and manifest.json for the upstream source SHA, license and any skipped assets.

Only source files were copied. gstack, Playwright and other CLIs require separate runtime setup, and upstream scripts were NOT executed.
